Title: Elite Variants
Author: mythraps
Description: Adds powerful elite and ultimate variant creatures with fully customizable difficulty. Features natural spawning based on player level and zone tier, mixed enhancements (mutations, cybernetics, equipment), elite army encounters, and 4 difficulty presets plus full custom configuration. Compatible with all creature mods.
